title: 第5章 万春谷前
content_zh:
“多谢仙童宽恕！大恩大德，小人一定牢记于心！”

    南离国丞相四儿子韦宝玉小心翼翼地抬眼看看，随后连忙带人离去，只留下老道、韩榆、大乌鸦以及八匹骏马在客栈的马棚前。

    因为韩榆的一句话，韦宝玉留下了带来的八匹骏马，这也是他们带来的唯一一种活物。

    等这些人走后，韩榆看向老道：“道爷……这能当血食吗？”

    老道咧嘴一笑：“能，太能了！不过就凭你这小身子骨，怎么享用这些血食呢？就不怕这些马一蹄子踢死你？”

    “还有，这里距离万春谷仙门不远，万一真的万春谷仙师出来扫除邪魔，你解释的清？”

    “道爷，我分你一半。”韩榆没怎么思索便脱口而出。

    “这还差不多！”

    老道满意地呵呵一笑：“回屋去喂乌鸦吧，接下来的事情不用你管了，明日我便去万春谷入仙门！”

    老道带着八匹马离开了客栈。

    韩榆回屋喂了乌鸦之后，修炼一番也开始休息。

    第二天一早，老道回到客栈，扔给韩榆一个带盖子、巴掌大小的小陶罐。

    “这是你那份炼血，这一个罐子里面够你三个月的血食，只要小心点省着用，用一年也未尝不可。”

    韩榆拿到小陶罐之后，还没来得及多说什么，老道已经风尘仆仆转身便走。

    韩榆连忙跟上去：“道爷，去万春谷吗？”

    老道头也不回，嘶哑的声音难掩激动：“不错，我要入仙门正途了！”

    韩榆便不再做声，默默跟在后面。

    大乌鸦在半空中嘎嘎叫两声，也跟着一老一小，离开人声熙攘的求仙镇，向着东边的万春谷而去。

    一开始路上还有人，越接近万春谷，人却是越少。

    韩榆心里面感觉古怪，求仙镇那么多人，万春谷这边为什么人反而越来越少？

    将疑问告诉老道，老道哈哈一笑：“世上假装求仙者多，真正求仙者少！如今距离万春谷招收新门徒的仙缘大典，还有一年多时间，谁敢无事上前滋扰仙门？”

    “到时候仙师把他灭杀，都得自认倒霉！”

    说到这里，又盯着韩榆：“小娃儿，你还敢跟我过去吗？”

    “我手中有信物，你可什么都没有，小心被万春谷的仙师杀掉！”

    韩榆点了点头。

    老道再也不说什么，只是向前而去。

    一老一小又走了小半日，眼前一片连绵的山林云雾缭绕，呼吸陡然清新顺畅，令人精神一振。

    远远看见一株苍翠巨树屹立在山前，巨树高耸入云，周围白鹤翩翩，树后白云飘荡，令人看不清楚究竟。

    这等仙门气派，更让老道来了劲头，不由自主地加快了脚步，韩榆也连忙跟上继续往前，大黑乌鸦也落下来，停在韩榆的肩膀上。
content_en:
"Thank you Fairy Boy for your forgiveness! This is a great kindness, I will definitely remember it in my heart!"

Wei Baoyu, the fourth son of the Prime Minister of Nanli Kingdom, looked up cautiously, and then quickly led the people away, leaving only Lao Dao, Han Yu, Da Crow and eight horses in front of the stable of the inn.

Because of Han Yu's words, Wei Baoyu kept the eight horses they brought, which were also the only living animals they brought.

After these people left, Han Yu looked at the old Taoist: "Master Tao...can this be used as blood food?"

The old Taoist grinned: "Yes, that's great! But with your small body and bones, how can you enjoy all this blood food? Aren't you afraid that these horses will kick you to death?"

"Also, this place is not far from the Immortal Gate of Wanchun Valley. If the real Immortal Master of Wanchun Valley comes out to eliminate evil spirits, can you explain it clearly?"

"Master Dao, I'll give you half." Han Yu blurted out without much thought.

"That's pretty much it!"

The old Taoist smiled with satisfaction: "Go back to the house and feed the crows. You don't have to worry about the rest. I will go to Wanchun Valley to enter the immortal gate tomorrow!"

The old Taoist left the inn with eight horses.

After Han Yu went back to the house and fed the crows, he practiced some exercise and began to rest.

Early the next morning, Lao Dao returned to the inn and threw Han Yu a small clay pot with a lid and the size of a palm.

"This is your share of blood refining. This jar contains enough blood food for you for three months. As long as you use it carefully and sparingly, it can last for a year."

After Han Yu got the small clay pot, before he could say anything more, the old Taoist turned around and left.

Han Yu quickly followed: "Master Tao, are you going to Wanchun Valley?"

The old Taoist didn't even look back, and his hoarse voice could not conceal his excitement: "Yes, I am going to enter the immortal sect on the right path!"

Han Yu stopped talking and followed silently.

The big crow squawked twice in the air, followed by an old man and a young child, leaving the bustling Qiuxian Town and heading towards Wanchun Valley in the east.

At first there were people on the road, but the closer we got to Wanchun Valley, the fewer people there were.

Han Yu felt strange in his heart. There were so many people in Qiuxian Town, but why were there fewer and fewer people in Wanchun Valley?

Telling the question to the old Taoist, the old Taoist laughed: "There are many people in the world who pretend to seek immortality, but few who really seek immortality! It is still more than a year before the Immortal Fate Ceremony to recruit new disciples in Wanchun Valley. Who dares to come forward and disturb the immortal sect without anything?"

"When the immortal master kills him, everyone will have to consider themselves unlucky!"

Having said this, he stared at Han Yu again: "Little boy, do you still dare to come with me?"

"I have a token in my hand, but you don't have anything. Be careful of being killed by the Immortal Master of Wanchun Valley!"

Han Yu nodded.

The old man said nothing more and just moved forward.

The old man and the young child walked for another half a day. They saw a continuous mountain forest shrouded in clouds and mist, and their breathing suddenly felt fresh and smooth, which was refreshing.

From a distance, I saw a giant green tree standing in front of the mountain. The giant tree towered into the clouds, surrounded by white cranes. White clouds were floating behind the tree, making it unclear what was going on.

This Immortal Sect style made the old Taoist even more energetic and he couldn't help but speed up his pace. Han Yu also quickly followed and continued to move forward. The big black crow also landed and stopped on Han Yu's shoulder.
title_en: Chapter 5 In front of Wanchun Valley
